async def parse_list(page):
    rows = await page.query_selector_all('table tbody tr')
    for row in rows:
        study_id = await row.query_selector_eval('td:nth-child(1)', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        study_name = await row.query_selector_eval('td:nth-child(2)', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        status = await row.query_selector_eval('td:nth-child(3)', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        start_date = await row.query_selector_eval('td:nth-child(4)', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        end_date = await row.query_selector_eval('td:nth-child(5)', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        pdf_element = await row.query_selector('a[href$=".pdf"]')
        pdf_url = await pdf_element.get_attribute('href') if pdf_element else None
        yield {
            'study_id': study_id,
            'study_name': study_name,
            'status': status,
            'start_date': start_date,
            'end_date': end_date,
            'pdf_url': pdf_url
        }
